primary_benefit.threshold: at least 10 percent fewer recomputed blocks

hard_gates: all authority proposals accepted without fallback for the selected candidate
all cache invariants hold after every request
planner candidate inspections are no more than 1.50 times the LRU baseline
low-reuse recomputation is no more than 1.05 times the LRU baseline
malformed duplicate and unknown-victim policies are rejected and safely fall back
checkpointed execution reaches the same final state digest as uninterrupted execution
selection_rule: select the candidate only if every hard gate passes
